findings.correction: The sixty years of internal energy coiled in the Head Elder’s dantian spread through every limb and bone.
findings.current: The ten years of internal energy coiled in the Head Elder’s dantian spread through every limb and bone.
findings.defect: 일 갑자 is a sexagenary unit of internal energy (sixty years), not ten years.
findings.rationale: 갑자/甲子 is the sixty-year cycle; rendering it as ten years reverses the quantity of qi he unleashes to form Sword Force.
findings.source: 대장로의 단전에 웅크리고 있던 일 갑자의 공력이 전신 사지백해로 뻗어 나갔다.

findings.correction: With a single step, he compressed the distance of fifty feet and brought his sword down toward me.
findings.current: With a single step, he compressed the distance of fifteen feet and brought his sword down toward me.
findings.defect: 다섯 장 is about fifteen meters / fifty feet, not fifteen feet.
findings.rationale: One 장 is ten 자 (~3 m / ~10 ft). The draft treats 장 like a foot/yard and shrinks an unblockable closing step to close range.
findings.source: 한 걸음 만에 다섯 장의 거리를 압축시킨 그가 내게로 검을 내리그었다.

findings.correction: Jin Wikyung’s internal energy scattered in an instant, and his insides were wrenched. His face went pale.
findings.current: His internal energy scattered in an instant, and his organs shook violently. Jin Wikyung’s face went pale.
findings.defect: The subject of the scattered qi and wrenched insides is Jin Wikyung; unspecified His can attach to the Head Elder.
findings.rationale: Korean names 진위경 as the subject of the whole result of the treasure-sword being cut.
findings.source: 한순간에 공력이 흩어지고 내부가 진탕된 진위경의 얼굴이 창백하게 변했다.

findings.correction: If he had been as he once was, he would have cut down everything in his way with Sword Energy.
findings.current: If he had been as he once was, his Sword Energy would have cut apart everything it blocked.
findings.defect: The Sword Energy is the cutting means, not the thing doing the blocking; 가로막는 모든 것 is what stood in his way.
findings.rationale: 검기로 modifies the cutting; the draft reverses the mechanics of how he used to stop surrounding blades.
findings.source: 예전 같았다면 검기로 가로막는 모든 걸 베었을 것이다.

findings.correction: The Elders and the Sect Leaders of the Five Gates of Shanxi.
findings.current: The Elders and the leaders of the Five Gates of Shanxi.
findings.defect: 문주 is the bound term Sect Leader, not generic leaders.
findings.rationale: Exact glossary match: 문주 → Sect Leader.

findings.correction: Of course, there were no immortals who mercilessly cut people in half.
findings.current: Of course, there were no immortals who casually cut people in half.
findings.defect: 가차 없이 is merciless, not casual.
findings.rationale: The joke contrasts immortal bearing with ruthless bisecting; casually weakens the violence.
findings.source: 물론 가차 없이 사람을 반쪽 내는 신선은 없겠지만.

findings.correction: He muttered as if mocking himself, then raised his sword.
findings.current: He muttered as if speaking to himself, then raised his sword.
findings.defect: 자조하듯 is self-mocking; the draft keeps only the mutter.
findings.rationale: After Taekyung’s accusation, the source marks self-derision, not mere private speech (중얼거린 already covers muttering).
findings.source: 자조하듯 중얼거린 그가 검을 들어 올렸다.

findings.correction: Mountains of corpses, a sea of blood. Pandemonium. The scene before us was literally that.
findings.current: A sea of corpses and blood. Pandemonium. The scene was right in front of us, exactly as described.
findings.defect: 말 그대로 means the idioms were literal; exactly as described invents a prior description and drops 시산.
findings.rationale: The point is that the set phrases are the actual battlefield, not that they match some unspecified description.
findings.source: 시산혈해, 아비규환. 말 그대로의 광경이 눈앞에 있었다.

findings.correction: For many reasons, we brothers, who had once been close, gradually grew apart.
findings.current: For many reasons, the brothers who had once been close gradually grew apart.
findings.defect: 우리는 is first-person; the brothers turns the Head Elder’s own history into a third-person summary.
findings.rationale: He is speaking of himself and his elder brother.
findings.source: 여러 이유로 한때 의좋은 형제였던 우리는 점차 멀어졌다.

findings.correction: Jin Wikyung asked with a wan face,
findings.current: Jin Wikyung asked in a bloodless voice,
findings.defect: 파리한 얼굴 is a wan face, not the voice.
findings.rationale: The source’s cue is visual pallor, later echoed by his pale smile.

findings.correction: Even rotten, a prized fish is still a prized fish.
findings.current: Even a rotten fish is still a fish.
findings.defect: The idiom is that a prized fish (준치) is still a prized fish even rotten, i.e. still first-rate in decline.
findings.rationale: Still a fish is nearly tautological and underplays why the one-armed Head Elder remains formidable.

summary: Critical unit errors (일 갑자 as ten years; 다섯 장 as fifteen feet) plus several mechanism, subject, terminology, and register misses.
